environmentalPersistence: Low — degrades via photolysis and microbial activity within days

lowDose.description: Mild defense priming, slight anthocyanin increase, no visible growth suppression. Hormetic — can mildly enhance antioxidant capacity.

highDose.description: Severe growth arrest, strong necrosis at leaf tips and margins, heavy stomatal closure, maximum anthocyanin expression.

morphologicalEffects.heightSuppression: Moderate — internodal elongation reduced via GA antagonism
morphologicalEffects.chlorosis: Mild to moderate — partial chlorophyll degradation
morphologicalEffects.necrosis: Leaf tip and margin necrosis at high doses; stem base darkening
morphologicalEffects.pigmentation: Strong purple/red anthocyanin accumulation — most visually distinctive effect
morphologicalEffects.rootGrowth: Moderately reduced; lateral roots mildly stimulated at low doses
morphologicalEffects.newVsOldLeaves: New apical leaves most sensitive — curl and pigment first

physiologyEffects.photosyntheticRate: Reduced via chlorophyll loss and stomatal closure

microbiomeEffects.fungalEffect: Beneficial mycorrhizae mildly suppressed at high doses

temporalDynamics.sensitization: Priming — faster response on second exposure

visualSimulation.colorChanges: Green → deep purple/red (anthocyanin); tips yellow-brown at necrosis
visualSimulation.damageSpread: Outward from tips, downward from apex over time
visualSimulation.damagePattern: Patchy early, more uniform at high doses
visualSimulation.recoveryVisual: Gradual fade toward green; necrotic tip scarring remains

synergies.synergyNote: MeJA + MeSA pushes both pigmentation and defense axes simultaneously — strongest anthocyanin response in Coleus
synergies.antagonismNote: GA partially reverses JA-mediated height suppression

educationalContext.realWorldSources: Jasmine flowers, rosemary, lavender — emitted naturally under herbivore attack
educationalContext.agriculturalUse: Experimental crop protection; stress resistance induction
educationalContext.humanToxicity: Low — no significant risk at typical concentrations
educationalContext.climateLink: Plants under climate stress upregulate JA signaling; relevant to climate adaptation research
educationalContext.whyStudentsCare: The plant's alarm chemical — released when insects attack, triggers whole-plant defense. Makes abstract plant immunity tangible.
educationalContext.realWorldIssue: Biological pest control, sustainable agriculture, plant communication
